title: pinus contorta subsp. bolanderi
intro: Pinus contorta subsp. bolanderi, commonly known as Bolander's twisted pine, is a subspecies of the lodgepole pine tree native to the western United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pinus contorta subsp. bolanderi include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in treating wounds, infections, and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
